b_k16.q: 意志品质类（信心 / 坚持 / 勇气）· 中心思想句
b_k16.eg: Self-confidence is so indispensable that the subject deserves the highest level of attention and consideration.
b_k16.egzh: 自信如此不可或缺，值得给予最高程度的重视与考量。（示范，主题词按题换）

b_k3.q: 2004 英一 · 备用引入（图片明确传达的是…）
b_k3.eg: What is clearly conveyed in the picture is that perseverance leads to success.
b_k3.egzh: 图片明确传达出的是：坚持带来成功。

b_k6.q: 2004 英一 · 单图五要素公式（环境 + 动作 + 主体 + doing + with）
b_k6.eg: As is symbolically depicted in the picture above, on the playground runs a young man, active as well as vigorous, rushing to the finishing line, with a sweet smile on his face.
b_k6.egzh: 如图象征性所示，操场上跑着一位年轻人，既活跃又有活力，正冲向终点线，脸上带着灿烂笑容。

b_k9.q: 2022 英一 · 两人谈讲座（对话型）
b_k9.eg: As is symbolically depicted in the picture above, in front of us stand two girls, talking about campus lectures. One argues that campus lectures are irrelevant to her major and a waste of time. By contrast, the other maintains that attending such lectures is highly beneficial nonetheless.
b_k9.egzh: 如图象征性所示，我们面前站着两位女生，正在谈论校园讲座。一人认为讲座与专业无关、浪费时间；另一人坚持认为参加仍大有裨益。

b_m1.q: 文字作文兜底 · 引出主题（任何文字题）
b_m1.eg: It cannot be denied that reading plays a key role in people's work and life.
b_m1.egzh: 不可否认，阅读在人们的工作和生活中起着关键作用。（示范，主题词按题换）

b_m4.q: 2026 英二 · 孩子与屏幕（社会普遍现象类）
b_m4.eg: With the rapid advancement of society and technology, children's addiction to screens has become a common phenomenon in our daily lives.
b_m4.egzh: 随着社会与科技的快速进步，孩子沉迷屏幕已成为日常生活中常见的现象。

b_m6.q: 文字题 · 题干要求「说明作者观点」时必写
b_m6.eg: According to the author, parents should set limits on children's screen time instead of blaming schools alone.
b_m6.egzh: 根据作者观点，家长应为孩子的屏幕时间设限，而不是只责怪学校。（示范，按原文改写）

b_m7.q: 文字题 · 观点同义说法（Therefore / In the author's view）
b_m7.eg: Therefore, the author holds that reading widely is essential to a college student's growth.
b_m7.egzh: 因此，作者认为广泛阅读对大学生的成长至关重要。（示范）

b_m8.q: 完全同意 · 观点积极正确的题必须表态
b_m8.eg: I fully agree with the author's viewpoint.
b_m8.egzh: 我完全同意作者的观点。

b_m9.q: 开放型题（如孩子沉迷屏幕该怪谁）· 三种立场都可
b_m9.eg: I strongly disagree with the author's opinion that schools should bear all the responsibility.
b_m9.egzh: 我强烈反对作者认为学校应承担全部责任的观点。（示范）

b_n1.q: 2026 英一 · 图表第一段整段（双图表 + 静态为主）
b_n1.eg: The chart on the left illustrates consumers' attitudes towards elderly-care robots, while the chart on the right presents their major concerns. To be specific, the proportions of respondents who fully accept, partially accept and reject these robots account for 39.3%, 32.8% and 27.9% respectively.
b_n1.egzh: 左图展示消费者对养老机器人的态度，右图呈现其主要顾虑。具体而言，完全接受、部分接受、拒绝的受访者分别占 39.3%、32.8%、27.9%。

b_n2.q: 2024 英二 · 第二段整段（举例 → 说理 → 群众）
b_n2.eg: Three key reasons, from my perspective, account for this phenomenon. To begin with, for instance, my roommate Kevin is passionate about practical courses, which helps him cultivate practical skills. What's more, no one can deny that practical courses play a crucial role in students' all-round development.
b_n2.egzh: 在我看来有三点原因。首先，例如我的室友 Kevin 热衷实践课程，这帮他培养实践技能；其次，无人能否认实践课对学生全面发展起关键作用。

b_n3.q: 2023 英二 · 第三段整段（总结 + 两条措施 + 畅想）
b_n3.eg: All in all, enough attention must be paid to public health literacy by ourselves and our community. For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to launch more health education campaigns. For another, ordinary individuals ought to spare no pains to attach great importance to health knowledge in daily life.
b_n3.egzh: 总之，我们自身与社会都必须高度重视公众健康素养。一方面政府应多办健康教育；另一方面普通人也应在日常重视健康知识。

b_n4.q: 2004 英一 · 图画第一段整段（只换第一段，二三段用 n2 / n3）
b_n4.eg: As is symbolically depicted in the picture above, in front of us stands a young man, rushing to the finishing line, with a sweet smile on his face. The primary intention of the drawing is to remind the whole society that perseverance is of vital importance.
b_n4.egzh: 如图象征性所示，我们面前站着一个年轻人，正冲向终点线，脸上带着笑容；这幅画意在提醒全社会，坚持至关重要。

b_n5.q: 文字题 · 第一段整段（引出 → 观点 → 表态）
b_n5.eg: It cannot be denied that screens play a key role in children's life. According to the author, parents should set limits on screen time. I fully agree with the author's viewpoint.
b_n5.egzh: 不可否认屏幕在孩子生活中起关键作用。作者认为家长应限制屏幕时间，我完全同意这一观点。

c_approx.q: 静态图 · 约数（数字不整时）
c_approx.eg: The figure stood at just over 60%.

c_contrast.q: 对比衔接 · 一句里两个方向（2019 英二）
c_contrast.eg: The proportion entering the workforce fell to 60.7%, whereas that pursuing further study rose to 34.0%.
c_contrast.egzh: 就业比例降至 60.7%，而深造比例升至 34.0%。

c_dec.q: 动态图 · 说「下降」时（2019 英二）
c_dec.eg: The percentage of graduates entering the workforce decreased remarkably from 68.1% to 60.7%.
c_dec.egzh: 直接就业的毕业生比例从 68.1% 大幅降至 60.7%。

c_fast.q: 动态图 · 「迅猛变化」（快递量示范）
c_fast.eg: The number of rural parcels rose dramatically after 2015.
c_fast.egzh: 农村快递量在 2015 年后急剧上升。（示范）

c_flat.q: 动态图 · 某段时间「持平」（示范）
c_flat.eg: The figure stood at roughly 30% throughout the period.
c_flat.egzh: 该数值在整个时期基本维持在 30% 左右。（示范）

c_fluct.eg: The share fluctuated between 10% and 15% over the decade.
c_fluct.egzh: 该比例十年间在 10%—15% 之间波动。（示范）

c_inc.q: 动态图 · 说「上升」时（2019 英二 / 2023 英二）
c_inc.eg: The proportion pursuing further study climbed significantly from 26.3% to 34.0%.
c_inc.egzh: 选择深造的比例从 26.3% 显著升至 34.0%。

c_mult.q: 倍数与比较 · 差距悬殊时（示范）
c_mult.eg: The number of online course takers is four times as high as that of offline ones.
c_mult.egzh: 在线课程人数是线下课程的四倍。（示范，倍数按题目换）

c_occupy.q: 静态图 · 说「占多少」时（2024 英二 / 2026 英一）
c_occupy.eg: Acquiring relevant knowledge accounts for 91.3% of students' gains.
c_occupy.egzh: 获得相关知识占学生收获的 91.3%。

c_peak.q: 动态图 · 「达到峰值」（快递量示范）
c_peak.eg: The volume peaked at 83 billion parcels in 2019.
c_peak.egzh: 快递量在 2019 年达到 830 亿件的峰值。（示范）

c_present.q: 图表开头 · 「图表显示了」（全部图表题）
c_present.eg: As is shown in the chart, graduates' choices changed significantly from 2013 to 2018.
c_present.egzh: 如图所示，毕业生去向在 2013—2018 年间发生了显著变化。

c_rank.q: 静态图 · 排名（2024 英二 / 2026 英一）
c_rank.eg: Acquiring relevant knowledge tops the list, at 91.3%, followed by improving practical skills at 84.8%.
c_rank.egzh: 获得相关知识以 91.3% 居首，其次是 84.8% 的提高实践技能。

c_ratio.q: 静态图 · 比例 / 份额（两两对比才用 ratio）
c_ratio.eg: The proportion of graduates pursuing further study rose to 34.0%, while the share starting a business stayed below 3%.
c_ratio.egzh: 深造比例升至 34.0%，而创业份额不足 3%。（示范）

c_slow.q: 动态图 · 「缓慢上升」（2023 英二健康素养）
c_slow.eg: The level increased gradually from 8.8% in 2012 to 25.4% in 2021.
c_slow.egzh: 该水平从 2012 年的 8.8% 逐步升至 2021 年的 25.4%。

c_time.q: 动态图 · 时间跨度（2019 英二 / 2023 英二）
c_time.eg: During the period from 2013 to 2018, graduates' choices underwent significant changes.
c_time.egzh: 2013—2018 年间，毕业生去向发生了显著变化。

c_trendnp.q: 趋势名词短语 · 主语是时间段（2023 英二）
c_trendnp.eg: The period from 2012 to 2021 witnessed a steady rise in residents' health literacy.
c_trendnp.egzh: 2012—2021 年间，居民健康素养稳步上升。

c_trough.q: 动态图 · 「触底后回升」（示范）
c_trough.eg: The figure bottomed out at 5% in 2015 before rising again.
c_trough.egzh: 该数值 2015 年触底至 5%，随后再度上升。（示范）

d_f24.q: 2018 英一选课 / 2024 英一公园（自己造一组对比）
d_f24.eg: Compared with simple lessons, difficult courses can develop students' critical thinking skills, so as to expand their horizons.
d_f24.egzh: 与简单课程相比，困难课程能培养学生的批判性思维，从而开拓视野。

d_m11.q: 养老机器人 · 双重否定变体（语气更硬）
d_m11.eg: The importance of elderly-care robots should never be underestimated by anyone.
d_m11.egzh: 任何人都绝不应低估养老机器人的重要性。（示范）

d_vn1.q: 2026 英一 · 态度 / 担忧 / 选择 / 偏好类题
d_vn1.eg: The chart on the left illustrates consumers' attitudes towards elderly-care robots, while the right one lists their major concerns.
d_vn1.egzh: 左图展示消费者对养老机器人的态度，右图列出其主要顾虑。

d_vn2.q: 2019 英二 · 变化 / 趋势 / 波动类题
d_vn2.eg: The chart above illustrates the changes in graduates' choices from 2013 to 2018.
d_vn2.egzh: 上方图表展示了 2013—2018 年毕业生去向的变化。
